notes.title: Holiday update!
notes.content:
Hello!
The New Year is almost here and so is our update!  We wish you all a happy new year and some new highscores in the Last Mage Standing!

Full changelog: http://steamcommunity.com/app/568030/discussions/0/154644928868267112/

Have a nice holidays!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We are happy to announce that the first major update for The Last Mage Standing will be released before the New Years Eve! 
The upcoming patch will add new spells, overall quality improvements and some christmass spirit.
